dev.line: A single zone and on demand, like a proof of concept, but nothing is thrown away: data is backed up and failed work is kept.

modules.observability_basic: Logs and basic metrics kept, so a run that fails is visible rather than silent.

poc.line: A single zone, started on demand, nothing kept warm, and nothing to pay for while nothing is calling it. This is what the platform deploys today.

modules.config_basic: Settings handed to the app as it starts.
modules.static_site_edge: Files served straight to visitors over HTTPS.
modules.http_api_serverless: Starts when a request arrives and costs nothing while nothing is calling it.
modules.observability_basic: Logs and basic metrics, kept for as long as the plan asks.

perf.line: Provisioned from the production plan: the same modules, the same patterns, on a separate network. Nothing here is guessed, and the numbers come from the load test rather than from this file.

modules.observability_basic: The same alarms as production, so a load test is measured the way the real thing is watched.

prod.line: Data across more than one zone, capacity warm on the request path, a queue in front of anything that bursts, and alarms on errors and latency. Capacity is set by a load test.

modules.config_basic: Settings from the environment, and anything secret kept out of the plan.
modules.static_site_edge: Served from storage that keeps copies across more than one zone.
modules.http_api_serverless: Warm capacity on the request path, so the first request after a quiet spell is not the slow one.
modules.observability_basic: Alarms on errors and latency, going to whoever is on call.
